subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His decision to quit his stable job and travel the world was driven by a sudden __caprice__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"caprice"** means a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior. (अचानक और अनियंत्रित परिवर्तन)

 
 
• **Example: **His decision to move to another country was driven by a caprice rather than logical reasoning.
 
 
 
• **"Impulse"** refers to a sudden strong and unreflective urge or desire to act. (प्रेरणा)
 
 
• **Example: **She bought the dress on an impulse, without thinking about the cost.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"caprice"** is **"impulse"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sorrow** (दुःख): A feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt deep sorrow after the loss of her pet.
 
 
 
• **Delight** (आनंद): Great pleasure or joy.
 
 
• **Example: **He was filled with delight when he received the news of his promotion.
 
 
 
• **Determination** (दृढ़ संकल्प): Firmness of purpose; resoluteness.
 
 
• **Example:** Her determination to succeed was evident in her hard work and perseverance.
 
 

16f:Tbda,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
